info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Prospect Campaign Execution Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of reviews for prospect campaign executions within the banking sales domain. With this endpoint, users can submit detailed evaluations of specific campaign executions, contributing to enhanced performance analysis. Typical consumers include sales teams and marketing analysts who assess campaign outcomes to refine strategies. By providing structured feedback, organizations can better understand client engagement and improve future campaigns.

post.summary: Create a new review for a prospect campaign execution.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit reviews for a specific prospect campaign execution identified by the resource ID. The review will provide feedback and insights that are essential for evaluating the campaign’s performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for a specific prospect campaign execution identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. The review data should be provided in JSON format conforming to the specified schema.
